units: 1.19.12 fixed point divided by 4096; a room cell is 44x44 spanning -22..+22

format.array: a run of 16-byte records at region-A offset 76
format.record: four i32: x1, z1, x2, z2 - the two ends of the doorway axis
format.count: derived from the relocation table, which holds one pointer per record. No count field was found. The result agrees with the door count implied by the room code's first letter for every room extracted.
format.walls: each segment crosses a boundary, so one end sits at +-22 and the other at +-25. If x is constant the segment crosses the north or south wall and x is the offset along it; if z is constant it is east or west.

geometry_is_not_shared.conclusion: door positions are specific to the (stage, variant, room) triple. NOT ONE of the 36 variant+room pairs has the same geometry in every stage it appears in, so a port cannot key a door table by room code alone. s01a_ga1's north door is at x=-6, s01b_ga1's at x=+5, s02a_ga1's at x=0 with the wall at z=20 rather than 22. Note that the room NAMES and counts are shared across stages, which is what made one tile set reskinned per area a reasonable earlier reading - the names are shared, the door geometry is not.
